scope: Vehicle body orientation only; source coordinates, routes, canonical IDs, lane queues and source population remain unchanged.

implementation.clock: Existing scalar simulation clock; no additional RAF or per-frame attribute upload
implementation.interpolation: Shortest-angle cubic easing retained by canonical actor ID; unchanged targets do not restart; explicit seek/context epoch resets
implementation.renderAndPicking: Body, sprite, contact shadow and CPU picking use the same orientation function

regression.failFirst: At a source 90-degree corner the previous renderer immediately returned pi/2 instead of retaining the preceding pi heading at transition start.
covered: stationary samples and scalar time do not upload heading buffers

browser.method: Separate Chromium, actual local source vehicles; read actual instanced GPU heading attributes and production interpolation through the existing development motion probe. No actor or route injection.
browser.title: OmniTwin · Живой мир

limits: Orientation verification preceded coordinated junction rollout; final integrated traffic requires its own QA.
SwiftShader video under concurrent local work rendered approximately four frames per second; this is not a hardware frame-rate or final graphics acceptance claim.
A source ping-pong endpoint reverses body orientation around its original center; no physical U-turn corridor is invented.
The body may temporarily lag a sharply changing source tangent while the bounded turn completes.
